description: Angular component for handling two-factor authentication login, including provider selection, verification code input, and resend code functionality.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuthLoginComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing the two-factor authentication login process, including provider selection, code verification, and resend logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up providers, and starts the timer for countdown.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and timers when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: sendVerificationCode
methods.description: Sends a verification code request to the server and handles errors.

methods.name: selectProvider
methods.description: Handles provider selection, updates form validators, and triggers code sending if necessary.

methods.name: sendCode
methods.description: Requests a resend of the verification code and manages countdown.

methods.name: cancelLogin
methods.description: Cancels the login process, either reverting to previous provider or logging out.

methods.name: updatedTime
methods.description: Updates countdown timer and resend button visibility.
